svg.title: How Combinatorial BPE works
svg.desc: Words are split into variation, prefix, core and suffix; inventories are learned under a shared budget; the model sums four embeddings and predicts the parts with a chained head.

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, 'Noto Sans CJK SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif

svg.text: here they all share the single core row the.

svg.text: The affix/core split is learned: an affix is kept only if it saves

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, 'Noto Sans CJK SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif

svg.text: more tokens than the core merge it would displace.

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, 'Noto Sans CJK SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif

svg.text: 3 + 108 + 16,193 + 80 = 16,384 rows = same as a 16k standard vocab.
